Email from [[Steve Sanders|Stephen Sanders]], organizer of the [[2026 Retro League]], to Retro League players with the final standings of [[2026 Retro League Event 3]] ([[Premiere - Death Star II]]) and the cumulative league scores after Event 3, sent 10 October 2026. It congratulates [[Andrew Bethell]] on winning in a Final Confrontation with [[Kevin Bing]], and announces that Event 4 ([[Classic (no v-cards) (Modified)|Classic No-V with Shields]]) starts on 11 October with [[Mike Adamson|Michael Adamson]] as tournament director.

== Source ==
* Email "2026 SWCCG Online Retro League Event 3 Premiere to Death Star II Final Standings" from Stephen Sanders to Retro League players, 10 October 2026. Received by [[Bill Bisco]] as a player and printed from Gmail to PDF on 12 October 2026; provided by Bill.

== Changes ==
* Redacted copy: every email address and the Gmail print header's page address are blacked out, and the pages are rasterised. The message text, names and standings are otherwise unchanged.
